metadata.name: dream_recall
metadata.description:
While Isaac has Dream Catcher, the names of the items it revealed are shown in the starting room after descending to a new floor. They disappear once the player leaves the starting room. !! REQUIRES External Item Descriptions (EID) as a dependency.
Special cases: 1. Glitched items are not shown. 2. If there are no items in the Treasure Room, nothing is shown.
Mod Config Menu option: (This feature requires subscribing to: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3701683951) 1.Always show in the starting room (if off, the names are shown only on the first entry to the starting room)
